title: The wandering song of the Nogais: contemporary interpretations of an epic tradition - ResearchSPAce
text: This study traces the foundational concept of Edige within the Nogai epic tradition, exploring what has survived oral transmission, for archetypes, cardinal characters and recurring themes. Moving into a musicological domain, materials, practices and traditions are collated and analysed for principles that define Nogai music in order that it might be documented, understood and re-made.
